Implemented and verified locally at commit 5f7152aada60335935843ddc968162f615337415 on work/pointwise-inverse-20261001, based exactly on consumer pin 9a4508351d74567147b8ea3221d82db89e5892b0. Clean isolated worktree: /private/tmp/reframe4s-pointwise-inverse-20261001. Original dirty main checkout untouched. Local commit only; no merge, push, publication or hosted-CI claim.

PointwiseInversion.displacement and displacementThenAffine accept declared coverage-reporting maps; affine removal is analytic and initialization is identity in displacement coordinates. No inverse lattice or silent fallback. Per-query result records original query, optional best covered point with its full-map Euclidean residual, update count, and Converged / MaxIterations / Diverged / LeftSupport / Failure(MapError). Reuses InversionSettings and fixed-point convention. Boundary extension never qualifies as covered. Frame owners validated. The API is a numerical estimator, not SpatialMap/SmoothIso or an exact inverse.

Evidence: 15 new shared tests cover constant/affine analytic inverses; independent bisection for smooth contractive and sampled linear/cubic maps; affine-scaled full-map tolerance; iteration limit, oscillation, divergence, support boundaries, owner mismatch, typed failures and overflow-safe residuals. Field suites: 51 tests JVM + 51 Scala.js, all pass. Explicit sbt root/compile root/test: 541 tests, 85 suite executions, zero failures/errors/ignored, no warning/error log lines. PRD validation and symbol ownership pass; diff whitespace check passes. Full logs, metadata, file/log SHA256s and commit binding: /private/tmp/reframe4s-pointwise-evidence/verification.json, field-tests-02.log, root-tests-02.log.

Existing repository caveats: verify-build-graph fails for undeclared scalafim-image -> reframe4s-lie; reproduced by extracting untouched base script/PRD/graph, all SHA256-identical to candidate inputs (base-graph.json). Documented compileAll/testAll aliases resolve to a nonexistent coreJVM project through composite build aliases; explicit root tasks pass. Neither unrelated issue was modified.

Consumer qualification remains ScalaFIM-owned and unperformed: real all-vertex oracle, voxel/value/support agreement, real JVM/Scala.js costs and BridgeExactness.Approximate integration. No anatomical-route qualification or measured speedup claimed. API and limitations: docs/pointwise-inversion.md. Consumer can use the local commit as its provider candidate; publication requires separate authorization.
